doc: Rainbow Falls pond room of dungeon d02 (Rainbow Butterfly Wood), loaded for floor 15 before the boss. The player throws a Lafrescia Seed and then a Sundrop into the pond (events 255a and 255b, flags 23 and 24) to grow a giant Lafrescia flower, and touching its vine (event 256) carries the party up to the d02b02 boss floor. Also handles the exit back out of the dungeon.
